title: 第27章 起始第28章 建设改第29章 风波
content_zh:
在沐云的规划中，忘忧村前期还是要以发展为主轴，先将忘忧谷的潜力开发出来。接着必须巩固忘忧谷的防护能力，虽说忘忧谷是存在于“秘地“当中，但是在未来，沐云还是得将军队带出去，不可能一直躲在忘忧谷中。
因此第二阶段，就必须逐渐的将整个忘忧谷掌控住。在考虑到未来“帝望“结束时，能将城市折叠后带到现世，沐云便打算将整个忘忧谷打包带走，留给沐氏集团。
以沐云对于规则的了解，这完全是可行的，只是这个工程太过庞大，必须一步一步来，急不得！沐云打算花一个游戏年的时间，来完成前两个阶段。
到了第二个游戏年，沐云就要开始整军备战，同时还要做好领地大扩张的准备，除了各种资源的储备以外，还要有足够的中低阶人才。
因为在第二年结束之后，“帝望“将迎来第一次历史剧情。届时，所有在野外建立的玩家领地，都将面对来自原住民NPC的狂潮。
大汉帝国这里，迎来的是“黄巾之乱“历史剧情，黄巾军的数量可不是历史上的三五十万，而是整整三千万！若是再加上玩家的数量，整个数量还要翻上几翻，就沐云所看到的未来，就达到了整整两亿。
重点来了！在第一次历史剧情中，哪怕是最弱的ＮＰＣ杂兵，都有着初入Ａ级的位阶和实力，而在第一次历史剧情过后，才会开启玩家转生的功能。所以在第一次历史剧情中，所有玩家的位阶上限就是凡人阶100等的层度，除了极少数玩家以外，即使是面对杂兵，也只有被切菜的份。
到了那个时候，大量的玩家领地被攻破，庞大的村民数量，只要让沐云咬下那么一小口，都能直接让领地的发展上快车道，更不用说那些黄巾降卒了。
＂所以阿！前面两个游戏年，保证领地不暴露才是最基本的。领地等级冲的越快，名声越大，只要暴露了位置，等历史剧情来了之后，死的也越快，死的也越惨！整个就是被原住民ＮＰＣ教做人的节奏。＂沐云在心中为未来领主玩家的苦难默哀三秒。
如果想要在历史剧情中有所斩获，除了不能暴露领地之外，还必需拥有一批由ＮＰＣ所组成的军队，想靠玩家战力来打天下，在第一次历史剧情中是不可能的事！
琢磨一番之后，沐云心里逐渐的完善了整个框架。
突然，沐云耳朵一动，似乎听到了些许声响。沐云转头一看，就看见远处迎来了几道身影。
＂建村后的第一批村民终于到了吗？＂沐云挑了挑眉，心中暗忖。
不久后，一名年近五十的中年男子，带着六名少年和三名妇人，缓缓的向着沐云的方向走来。靠近之后，他们便突然停了下来，而为首的中年男子却走到了沐云的近前。
＂这位公子，请问村里大人在否？＂中年男子对着沐云微微一拱手后说道。
＂你们是哪边人？要找什么大人？＂沐云看着中年男子，微微一笑。
＂在下唐突了。在下姓章名群，字仲颌。我等本是山外的涯领村民，只因盗匪猖獗，不得不以命相搏，最后终于翻山越岭来到此地。想问公子，您家大人是否能行个方便？我等已有数日未得进食了。＂中年男子章群一脸诚恳的对着沐云说道。
＂且先跟我来吧！诸事不急，届时在说。＂沐云说完，便径自往村里走了进去。
犹豫了片刻后，章群看了看身后众人，便微微一叹，领着他们进了忘忧村。
到了村长居所，沐云便拿出了食粮和水，交与了章群。而章群将食粮和水交付了众人后，他才开始吃了起来。

等待众人吃饱喝足，沐云才对着章群说道：＂这位先生，我看你等现在并无落脚之处，可否愿意在我忘忧村住下？＂
章群看了看众人之后，脸色微微有所意动，但是他又看了看沐云，不知道想说些什么。
沐云笑了笑，说道：＂先生可是在看我忘忧村？＂
章群讪笑了一声：＂让公子见笑了，不知公子如何称呼？村里的大人不知去了何处？＂
＂是我让先生见笑了。在下沐云，忝为本村村长，忘忧村现在也就仅我一人，没其他大人了。＂沐云看着脸色有些讶异的章群，又说道：＂先生放心，忘忧村或许新立，但是吃食等方面却能保证无虞。再说，先生您觉得现在，你等还有其他更好的出路？＂
章群闻言愣了一下，然后便连声笑道：＂哈哈哈，是我着相了！＂随后，章群便向着沐云行了一礼：＂在下章群，拜见大人。＂
一看章群向着沐云行礼，其他众人也连忙向着沐云行礼说道：＂拜见大人。＂
＂诸位，请先跟我来吧！＂沐云没有还礼，只是微一错身之后，便走进了村长居所。
众人看了看章群，只见章群摇了摇头，说道：＂这位公子虽年幼，但观其言行举止诸般仪态，绝非泛泛之辈。＂
＂我等还是跟上吧。＂章群说完，便跟着进了村长居所。众人对眼一看，也纷纷的进了。
眼看众人都进了里面，沐云这才拿出了征西将军的官印与虎符，年幼的脸庞一阵肃然。
＂我乃大汉天子所封的征西将军，现于此地建村，尔等可愿跟随与我？＂沐云的声音虽然稚嫩，听在众人耳里却如平地闻惊雷，顿时都蒙了。
＂草民章群，拜见大人。＂章群的反应最快，立刻俯伏于地，然后大声的说道。
＂草民张庭，拜见大人。＂
＂草民张灿，拜见大人。＂
＂民妇陈俞，拜见大人。＂
......
等到众人都俯伏于地，沐云才突然说道：＂章群。＂
＂草民在。＂
＂命你为忘忧村副村长，可有异议？＂

章群闻言一惊，便抬起了头。当他看见沐云的笑容后，便愣了一下，随后身体便再度向下一拜：＂莫敢不从。＂
＂起来吧！＂
＂谢大人。＂众人齐声道。
content_en:
In Muyun's plan, Wangyou Village should still focus on development in the early stage, and first develop the potential of Wangyou Valley. Next, the protective capabilities of Wangyou Valley must be consolidated. Although Wangyou Valley exists in a "secret place", in the future, Mu Yun still has to take the army out, and it is impossible to hide in Wangyou Valley all the time.
Therefore, in the second stage, we must gradually control the entire Wangyou Valley. Considering that when "Emperor's Hope" ends in the future, the city can be folded and brought to the present world, Mu Yun plans to pack up the entire Wangyou Valley and leave it to the Mu Group.
Based on Mu Yun's understanding of the rules, this is completely feasible, but this project is too huge and must be done step by step. There is no rush! Mu Yun plans to spend a game year to complete the first two stages.
In the second game year, Mu Yun will begin to prepare for war. At the same time, he will also need to prepare for a major expansion of his territory. In addition to the reserves of various resources, he must also have enough middle and low-level talents.
Because after the end of the second year, "Diwang" will usher in its first historical plot. By then, all player territories established in the wild will face a wave of aboriginal NPCs.
Here in the Han Empire, what is ushering in is the historical plot of the "Yellow Turban Rebellion". The number of the Yellow Turban Army is not the historical three and a half million, but a full 30 million! If the number of players is added together, the entire number will increase several times, and as far as Mu Yun sees the future, it will reach a full 200 million.
Here comes the point! In the first historical plot, even the weakest NPC soldiers have the rank and strength to enter the A-level for the first time. After the first historical plot, the function of player reincarnation will be enabled. Therefore, in the first historical plot, the upper limit of all players' ranks is the 100th level of the mortal level. Except for a very small number of players, even if they face miscellaneous soldiers, they will only be cut into pieces.
By that time, a large number of player territories have been breached, and the huge number of villagers, as long as Mu Yun takes a small bite, can directly put the development of the territory on the fast track, not to mention those yellow scarf soldiers.
"So! In the first two game years, it is most basic to ensure that the territory is not exposed. The faster the territory level rises, the greater the reputation. As long as the location is exposed, when the historical plot comes, the death will be faster and the more tragic the death will be! The whole thing is the rhythm of being taught by the indigenous NPC." Mu Yun silently mourned for the suffering of the future lord players for three seconds in his heart.
If you want to gain something in the historical plot, in addition to not exposing your territory, you must also have an army composed of NPCs. It is impossible to conquer the world with the strength of players in the first historical plot!
After thinking about it for a while, Mu Yun gradually perfected the entire framework in his mind.
Suddenly, Mu Yun's ears moved and he seemed to hear some noises. Mu Yun turned around and saw several figures coming from a distance.
"Have the first batch of villagers finally arrived after the establishment of the village?" Mu Yun raised his eyebrows and thought to himself.
Not long after, a middle-aged man in his late fifties, with six teenagers and three women, slowly walked towards Mu Yun's direction. After getting closer, they suddenly stopped, and the middle-aged man at the head walked up to Mu Yun.
"Master, may I ask if the adults in the village are here?" the middle-aged man said after slightly cupping his hands to Mu Yun.
"Who are you from? What kind of adult are you looking for?" Mu Yun looked at the middle-aged man and smiled.
"I'm being rude. My surname is Zhang Mingqun, and my courtesy name is Zhongja. We are originally villagers from Yaling outside the mountains, but due to rampant banditry, we had to fight for our lives. Finally, we crossed the mountains and ridges to get here. I would like to ask, Sir, if your master can make it easier? We haven't eaten for several days." The middle-aged man Zhang Qun said to Mu Yun with a sincere face.
"Come with me first! Don't worry, we'll talk about it later." After Mu Yun finished speaking, he walked directly into the village.After hesitating for a moment, Zhang Qun looked at the people behind him, then sighed slightly and led them into Wangyou Village.
When they arrived at the village chief's residence, Mu Yun took out the food and water and handed them to Zhang Qun. After Zhang Qun handed over the food and water to everyone, he started to eat.
After everyone had eaten and drank, Mu Yun said to Zhang Qun: "Sir, I see that you have no place to stay now. Are you willing to stay in my Wangyou Village?"
After Zhang Qun looked at everyone, his face was slightly moved, but he looked at Mu Yun again, not knowing what to say.
Mu Yun smiled and said, "Sir, are you looking at my Wangyou Village?"
Zhang Qun laughed sarcastically: "Young Master is making me laugh. I wonder what you call him? Where have the adults in the village gone?"
"I am the one who made Sir laugh. Myself, Mu Yun, as the head of this village, I am the only one in Wangyou Village now, and there are no other adults." Mu Yun looked at Zhang Qun, who looked a little surprised, and said, "Sir, don't worry, Wangyou Village may be newly established, but food and other aspects can be guaranteed. Besides, Sir, do you think there are other better ways out for you now?"
Zhang Qun was stunned for a moment when he heard this, and then he laughed continuously and said: "Hahaha, it's me who's in trouble!" Then, Zhang Qun saluted to Mu Yun: "I'm going to see you, Sir."
Seeing Zhang Qun salute to Mu Yun, everyone else quickly saluted to Mu Yun and said, "Greetings, your lord."
"Everyone, please come with me first!" Mu Yun did not return the gift, but turned slightly and walked into the village chief's residence.
Everyone looked at Zhang Qun, only to see Zhang Qun shake his head and said: "Although this young master is young, judging from his words, deeds and manners, he is by no means an ordinary person."
"I'll follow you later." After Zhang Qun finished speaking, he followed into the village chief's residence. Everyone looked at each other and entered one after another.
Seeing that everyone had entered, Mu Yun took out the official seal and tiger talisman of General Zhengxi, and his young face became solemn.
"I am the General of the Western Conquest appointed by the Emperor of the Han Dynasty. I am here to build a village. Are you willing to follow me?" Although Mu Yun's voice was childish, it sounded like thunder to everyone's ears, and they were all dumbfounded.
"Caomin Zhang Qun, pay homage to your lord." Zhang Qun reacted the fastest, immediately fell to the ground, and then said loudly.
"Caomin Zhang Ting, pay homage to your lord."
"Caomin Zhang Can, pay homage to your lord."
"Chen Yu, a civilian woman, pays homage to your lord."
...
When everyone was prostrate on the ground, Mu Yun suddenly said: "Zhang Qun."
"The grassroots are here."
"I appoint you as the deputy village chief of Wangyou Village. Do you have any objections?"
Zhang Qun was shocked when he heard this and raised his head. When he saw Mu Yun's smile, he was stunned for a moment, and then he bowed down again: "Don't dare to disobey."
"Get up!"
"Thank you, sir." Everyone said in unison.
